subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The executives were __running around in circles__, without any success.

options.text: Putting efforts into something that does not give a worthwhile result

solution:
The correct answer is: **Putting efforts into something that does not give a worthwhile result.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"running around in circles"** means putting in a lot of effort but not achieving any significant result. (बेकार की मेहनत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The team was running around in circles trying to fix the problem, but nothing seemed to work.
 
 
 
• **"Putting efforts into something that does not give a worthwhile result"** refers to expending energy and resources on activities that do not lead to success or productive outcomes. (ऐसी चीज़ में प्रयास करना जो कोई सार्थक परिणाम नहीं देती है)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite working hard all year, they were running around in circles because their strategy was flawed from the beginning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Putting efforts into something that does not give a worthwhile result**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Achieving maximum mileage** (अधिकतम लाभ प्राप्त करना): Getting the most benefit or advantage from something.

 
 
• **Example:** By optimizing their marketing strategy, they were able to achieve maximum mileage from their campaign.
 
 
 
• **Suffering huge profits and losses** (बड़े मुनाफे और नुकसानों का सामना करना): Experiencing significant financial gains and losses.
 
 
• **Example: **The volatile stock market led to the company suffering huge profits and losses within a short period.
 
 
 
• **Successfully accomplishing the target** (लक्ष्य को सफलतापूर्वक प्राप्त करना): Achieving the set goal or objective successfully.
 
 
• **Example:** After months of hard work, the team successfully accomplished the target and celebrated their achievement.
